summary: Frontend-only refactoring verification of /technical-reports modals (StatusChangeModal, DeleteRelatorioModal, EmailModal, CronometroFuncaoPopup, StopCronometroPopup, WorkKmPopup) extracted from TechnicalReports.jsx. Login + listing + 3 of 4 visible modals verified working. Found one encoding regression introduced by the refactor in utils/labels.js (mojibake double-encoded Portuguese chars) which I fixed.

Note: every page load logs 'IDBDatabase NotFoundError: One of the specified object stores was not found' — pre-existing client/relatorios cache bug, not related to this refactor.
rca of the issue: RCA encoding regression: When utils/labels.js was created during the refactor, the Portuguese string literals were saved as latin-1 byte sequences that represent UTF-8-encoded characters — i.e. the bytes 0xC3 0xA7 (which together encode 'ç' in UTF-8) were stored as the visible 2-char sequence 'Ã§'. Effect: any consumer reading the file as UTF-8 sees doubly-encoded mojibake. The bug was only visible inside StatusChangeModal because TechnicalReports.jsx kept its own correctly-encoded duplicate getStatusLabel and continued to pass that to ReportCard, masking the issue on the listing. Mitigation: re-saved labels.js as proper UTF-8.
